column6: Queued (deferred) unless the 4th arg bDirectProcess is true; lua_tinker reads a missing arg as nil->false (KTDXApp.h:95, KTDXApp.cpp:1320-1327). When true it runs each active stage MsgProc directly (KTDXApp.cpp:1298-1302). The only direct Lua dispatch, KM_UI_CONTROL_CUSTOM_FUNC, treats wParam as a const char*, which a Lua number cannot supply. Other uMsg values go to C++ handlers of unbounded depth
